common: Original instrumental for a cinematic night motor-racing thriller commercial. No vocals, no singing, no spoken words. 128 bpm, D minor palette, analog synth bass, live drums, distorted guitar, tension strings. Starts instantly with no fade in.

sections.name: A
sections.prompt: Section: suspense chase. From the first beat a driving pulsing synth-bass arpeggio and a ticking clock hi-hat, tense and sparse so dialogue sits on top. Builds every four bars with rising strings, low toms and filtered risers; short sharp dissonant stabs at about 0:03, 0:10 and 0:14. At 0:19 everything drops away to one held low drone and a slowing tick, getting quieter, fading to near silence by 0:23, then silence to the end.

sections.name: B
sections.prompt: Section: energetic sport-action drive. Opens on a massive drum and guitar slam at 0:00 at full energy, relentless driving drums and distorted guitar riff; a hopeful major-key synth lead motif enters at 0:04; a huge triumphant anthemic lift with a crash cymbal at 0:11, victory energy until 0:17, then it eases down to a lighter groove by 0:19.

sections.name: C
sections.prompt: Section: warm confident finale. A lighter, warm, upbeat groove in F major with a soft synth pulse, muted guitar and light drums, lots of space for speech, the hopeful motif played quietly; a gentle lift at 0:08; from 0:14 the motif grows into a bright, upbeat final sting that ends on a clean, punchy button hit at 0:19 with a short tail.
